title: Risk Simulation
description: Estimate outcome ranges and probabilities with random market paths instead of a single assumed return.

list.empty: No scenarios yet. Create one to get started.
list.delete_confirm: Deleting this scenario also removes all its runs. Continue?

empty.title: Select or create a scenario
empty.description: Simulations never touch the ledger and never affect net worth or spending statistics.

form.name: Scenario name
form.ratio_hint: Enter rates as decimals, e.g. 7% is 0.07.

correlation.hint: The matrix must be symmetric with 1 on the diagonal and positive definite; editing one side updates the other.
correlation.single_asset: Correlation is not needed for a single asset.

issue.not_positive_definite: These correlations cannot hold simultaneously (the matrix is not positive definite). Please adjust.

run.save_first: Save the scenario before running a simulation.
run.cancelled_hint: Run cancelled; results were not saved.

result.no_run_hint: Start a simulation from the Runs tab.
result.waiting: Simulation in progress; results appear automatically when done
result.unavailable_hint: Go back to Runs and start a new simulation.

metric.median_hint: Half of the paths end above this
metric.range_hint: 80% of paths fall in this range
metric.loss_hint: Share of paths ending below total contributions
metric.real_loss_hint: Share still below contributions after inflation
metric.target_hint: Share of paths reaching the target amount
metric.drawdown_hint: 90% of paths draw down no more than this

drawdown.title: Maximum drawdown distribution
drawdown.note: Drawdown is measured on the investment growth index, excluding contributions, so steady investing cannot mask it.

notice.title: Assumptions and precision
notice.small_sample: Only {{count}} paths; percentiles are noisy. Consider increasing the path count.
notice.stress_note: This is a deterministic stress scenario: {{preset}}. It is not a probability distribution.
notice.disclaimer_model: Returns follow a lognormal model; historical means and the normal distribution cannot fully cover tail risk.
notice.disclaimer_not_promise: The result is a probability distribution, not a promise of returns.
notice.disclaimer_costs: Apart from the fee rate you entered, taxes and your actual trading costs are not included.
notice.disclaimer_sampling: Sampling introduces error; larger path counts are more stable.
notice.disclaimer_deterministic: A deterministic scenario has a single path, so percentiles and probabilities do not apply.

stress.hint: Stress scenarios are deterministic extreme paths, shown separately from random results.

crash.label: Market crash
crash.description: A 35% single-month drop, recovering over two years

stagflation.label: Stagflation
stagflation.description: Five years of low returns and high inflation

lost_decade.label: Lost decade
lost_decade.description: Ten years flat in nominal terms

suggestion.applied: Asset weights filled from the portfolio holdings
suggestion.note_low: History is too short, so return and volatility were left blank. Please set them manually.
